groups.intro: Create WhatsApp groups from your business number, share the invite link, and handle join requests. Conversations appear in your inbox like any other chat.
groups.loadFailed: The groups could not be loaded.
groups.numbersDenied: You can see groups but not the list of WhatsApp numbers they belong to. Ask an admin for access to WhatsApp numbers.

rail.title: Groups
rail.howInvite: Groups are invite-only. You create the group, WhatsApp gives you an invite link, and you share that link — people choose to join. There is no way to add someone directly.
rail.howCost: Every message you send is charged once per person who receives it. A message to 100 members costs 100 sends.

noNumber.title: No WhatsApp Business number connected
noNumber.message: Groups need a WhatsApp number connected through the official WhatsApp Business Platform.
noNumber.hint: Connect one under Settings, Channels, WhatsApp.

notEligible.title: This number cannot use groups yet
notEligible.message: WhatsApp only opens the Groups feature to Official Business Accounts — the verified tier with the green badge. Your number is connected and working for normal chats; it just has not been granted group access.
notEligible.hint: Apply for Official Business Account status in WhatsApp Manager, then reload this page.

providerUnsupported.title: Groups are not available on this route
providerUnsupported.message: This number is reached through another provider, not directly through Meta. Groups have only been set up for numbers connected directly to Meta.
providerUnsupported.hint: Connect the number with Meta directly, or ask the provider whether they support Groups.

missingCredentials.title: This number needs to be reconnected
missingCredentials.message: No access token is stored for this number, so WhatsApp cannot be asked about groups.
missingCredentials.hint: Replace the token on the number's health page.

state.checkFailed: WhatsApp could not be asked whether this number can use groups just now. Everything below still works if it can; if an action fails, try again in a moment.
